table.name: TLGNR_CONTAINER_TYPE_BS
table.description: Types of Containers. The type of a container characterizes special abilities/requirements. We currently distinguish 'unloading horizontally' and 'unloading only when tilted' as the two unloading possibilities. Containers which are fix installed on a rail wagon have their unloading pipes at the side, and are never tilted.

column.name: CONTAINER_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 1=unloading horizontally (unloading pipes at its side), 2=unloading only when tilted (unloading pipes at back)

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
